snippets.snippet_text: "Personally when I first started my business online and selling my digital planners. I jumped from Etsy to Gumroad to Payhip trying to find out which one of the three platforms could help me make consistent sales. After testing all the three, I realized something which is very crucial for every seller must know and that is: Each platform works differently, depending on your goals."
